answer: Receipts are issued in jade, burned on slash in relic, and listed in cedar. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 53 epochs. That removes the yield an attacker would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Scaling to 230 identities multiplies that fee by 572 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
